answer.reason: The "How it works" section is rendered by the "Process" component (reference name `Steps`), which displays a shared grid of numbered items linked via its `StepItems` field. That field's linked content model is "Step" (reference name `StepItem`), explicitly described as "Used in the Steps component." Each stage of the how-it-works process is one Step/StepItem record (with Title and Description fields), so a new fourth stage should be added as a new content item in the StepItem model/container.
